meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并编辑带格式的Word文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作或修改格式复杂的Word文档。
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit formatted Word documents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently produce or modify Word documents with complex formatting.

howto.what: 让 Claude 生成带目录、标题、页码等格式的 Word 文档(报告、信件等)。它也能读取已有 .docx,或修改排版、插图、查找替换、加批注和修订。
howto.when: 当用户提到 Word 文档、.docx 等词,或要求生成报告、备忘录、信件等 Word 文件,或要求提取内容、插图、查找替换等操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一份 Word 报告,带目录、标题和页码。
say.note: Claude 会写出 .docx 文件并保存给你。

say.text: 把这份 .docx 里的内容提取成要点。
say.note: Claude 会读取文档并概括内容。

say.text: 把文档中所有‘待办’改成‘已完成’,并保留修订标记。
say.note: Claude 会做查找替换并记录为修订。

howto.what_en: Create formatted Word docs (TOC, headings, page numbers) for reports, letters, etc. Read existing .docx, edit layout, insert images, find-and-replace, add comments and tracked changes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions Word documents, .docx, etc., or asks for a Word file (report, memo, letter), or requests extracting content, inserting images, or find-and-replace.

say_en.text: Generate a Word report with a table of contents, headings, and page numbers.
say_en.note: Claude writes a .docx file and saves it for you.

say_en.text: Extract key points from this .docx file.
say_en.note: Claude reads the document and summarizes it.

say_en.text: Replace every 'TODO' with 'DONE' in the document, keeping tracked changes.
say_en.note: Claude does find-and-replace and records it as a revision.
